features.feature: Produce one auditable Markdown execution plan at the sole allowed content path, organized so the user can audit the current boundary, target design, rollout, tests, and follow-up implementation.
Document current ownership across milestone ledger, ProofStory acceptanceBindings, verificationIntent, verificationEvidence, REVIEW completeness, and lifecycle gates.
Keep the milestone ledger as the intent-totality owner and extend existing ProofStory-owned acceptance structures rather than duplicating claims or completion state.
Define explicit producer, consumer, positive-path, mutation, and transcript verification topology for each acceptance claim.
Specify auditable topology schema fields, reference-only ownership, authority, freshness, totality, failure codes, and derived rendering.
Specify an early PLAN-to-DEV structural acceptance_topology_check that detects missing or invalid topology before implementation.
Specify a DEV-to-REVIEW executable pre_review_check that requires typed, fresh evidence and mutation polarity before REVIEW.
Specify process-fact registration and mechanical CLI/handler/gate enforcement for every future gate-consumed artifact or semantic.
Specify legacy-safe observe, warn, and enforce rollout plus migration and applicability behavior, including docs-only compatibility.
Specify bounded implementation waves/stories and exact likely code touchpoints without performing those changes.
Specify positive and negative controls, mutation/bite tests, success metrics, risks, open decisions, and an independent reviewer audit rubric.
Clearly distinguish current implemented behavior from proposed behavior so the plan cannot be mistaken for shipped runtime assurance.
Render any acceptance matrix only as a derived view; do not create a parallel acceptance_matrix truth source.
features.excluded_by: A standalone persisted acceptance_matrix is explicitly rejected; only a derived rendering of canonical ProofStory and milestone references is in scope.

features.feature: Do not implement runtime code, CLI behavior, schemas, handlers, prompts, configuration, tests, package versions, or generated runtime artifacts in this story.
features.excluded_by: The user requested an auditable execution document before authorizing implementation; this is a documentation-only maintenance story.

features.feature: Use B-407c only as motivating evidence and do not modify it or claim its late-discovered obligations are already fixed by this story.
features.excluded_by: B-407c is evidence for the failure mode, not a modification target or completion claim.

features.feature: Do not modify unrelated documents, unrelated untracked work, docs/story, packages, tests, package manifests, or OMX artifacts.
features.excluded_by: The execution boundary allows one decision-document content path and Lattice-mediated story metadata only.
